options:
SELECT order_id,
  sum(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) AS tong
FROM order_items
GROUP BY order_id;

SELECT oi.order_id,
  sum(oi.quantity * p.price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS tong
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY oi.order_id;

SELECT order_id,
  sum(quantity * unit_price) AS tong
FROM order_items
GROUP BY order_id;

SELECT order_id,
  sum(quantity * unit_price * discount) AS tong
FROM order_items
GROUP BY order_id;

query: SELECT count(*) FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price <> p.price

GROUP BY product_id
HAVING count(unit_price) > 1;

SELECT product_id
FROM order_items
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING count(DISTINCT order_id) > 1;

SELECT product_id
FROM order_items
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING count(DISTINCT unit_price) > 1;

SELECT product_id
FROM order_items
WHERE count(DISTINCT unit_price) > 1
GROUP BY product_id;
